messages:
Ava Morgan: Quick note  Private 2.4 will include the Attestation Manager for on-prem bundles. It produces a verifiable evidence package for audits and an attestations export endpoint. Rolling invites start next week.
Diego V.: Tech details: installer flag --attest=enable. Attest package path: /var/lib/redwood/attest-{ts}.zip. For air-gapped installs we ship an offline generator script (see runbook).
Nia Patel: Compliance: default evidence retention set to 180 days; customers can change via the Audit API. We added PII handling guidance to the playbook. Legal needs to sign off before we publish external docs.
Omar Khan: Ops: online upgrade path is non-disruptive, ~20m per node. Note: customers using custom controller certs must include SANs for the attest service or the attestation upload will fail. Add to upgrade checklist.
Ava Morgan: One-pager and email template will be posted tomorrow 09:00 PT. CSMs: offer a 45-min audit-assist session as an upgrade option; add checkbox to the upgrade flow.
deploy-bot: Release schedule updated: private-2.4-attestation-manager -> staging 1965100000, prod cohort rollouts start 1965686400. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/private-2-4-attest (WIP).
